$comment: Version support matrix for the dsh-code-factory bundle plugin.
Hand-maintained on purpose: this file is the declaration an operator reads
before installing, and the input `scripts/doctor.mjs` checks the live
installation against. Keep it in sync with package.json (peerDependencies,
engines, dsh.bundle.patch, dsh.client.inject) whenever either side moves.
name: dsh-code-factory

@deepseek-ai/schemastery.role: Config schema for the plugin entry

@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent.role: Agent/session types used by the tool surface

@deepseek-ai/dsh-session.role: SessionId brand types for durable member sessions (types only; the plugin never appends session events — see docs/API-CONTRACTS.md §1.7)

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.role: defineTool for the factory_* tool surface

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots.role: client slot registration (cockpit panel, conversation card)

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout.role: full-width layout slot for the cockpit

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar-right.role: sidebar entry that opens the cockpit

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat.role: chat-side rendering used by the cockpit panel

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection.role: client transport for the /code-factory HTTP status route

@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller.role: session controller face exposed to the Web panel

packagesNote: Every entry above is an OPTIONAL peerDependency in package.json: the DSH shell provides them at runtime, so an incompatible version blocks activation instead of being installed. `react` (^18.2.0) is the only non-@deepseek-ai runtime peer (the shell provides it to lib/client.js via require()).

hostServices.notes: Bare cordis service keys (API-CONTRACTS §1.1). `webServer` gates the /code-factory status route, `commands` gates the /factory slash command; both fall back to alternative keys where the reference plugin does (webServer|httpServer).

gateCommands.$comment: Gate and DoD commands may ONLY come from the pipeline templates in src/domain/pipeline.ts, never from model output. The two entries below are the exported constants TEST_COMMAND / DELIVERY_CHECK_COMMAND; the build/compile commands are authored in the same template (npm run build --if-present for JS/TS stacks, python -m compileall for Python stacks).

verification.l1Subjects: lib/domain (pure logic) + lib/store (durable state) + lib/store/lock (lock detach & FIFO serialisation) + lib/runtime (scheduler planner decisions & the shipped fake-host model)
verification.l1Sections: A role registry & routing / B pipeline integrity / C gate verdicts / D Definition of Done / E store round-trip / F lock detach & serialisation / G harness self-check / H stranded attempt recovery & executor verdict / I planner decision consistency & the shipped fake-host model / J actionable alerts derived from the record / K the member token reading is real. F/H/I double as the red-proven regression guards for the three defects that were only ever found offline (F = lock detach, t22; H = stranded attempt recovery + the three-state executor verdict, t21; I = parked decisions keeping `parkedFrom`, t25/t23): each guard was proven to fail by mutating a throwaway copy of lib/ and re-running this suite.
verification.l1SourceAudit: Section F also audits the source tree (src/**): every session-lifecycle call site must sit inside runDetachedFromFactoryLocks(...); it needs a repository checkout, not just lib/
